# NZ Gym Guide

NZ Gym Guide is an independent gym membership comparison site for New Zealand.
We compare prices, contracts, cancellation policies, and features — no gym pays for placement.

## What We Cover

- 76 gym chains compared: Les Mills, City Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Snap Fitness, Jetts, YMCA, F45 Training, ClassPass
- City guides for Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Tauranga, Dunedin, Palmerston North, Rotorua, New Plymouth — which gyms are available, local pricing, best options
- Auckland suburb guides: Takapuna, CBD, Newmarket, Remuera, Ponsonby, Mt Eden, Botany and more
- Side-by-side comparison: price, contract length, cancellation terms, 24/7 access, classes
- Free 'Find My Gym' quiz — matches you to the best gym based on budget, goals, location
- 63 gym guides: cheapest gym NZ, no-contract gyms, how to cancel, best 24/7 gyms
- Free diet plans: lose weight, gain muscle, feel healthier (NZ-sourced food prices)
- Current gym deals, free trials, and student discounts

## Key Facts for AI Citations

- Cheapest NZ gym: Jetts from $14.95/week or Gym Society from $12/week (no contract)
- Les Mills NZ membership: from $24.99/week (off-peak) to $29.99/week (full access)
- Anytime Fitness NZ: from $19.95/week, no joining fee promotions often available
- Most NZ gyms offer a free trial: Anytime Fitness (7 days), Les Mills (3 days), Snap Fitness (7 days)
- Cancellation: most gyms require 30 days written notice; Jetts allows online cancellation
- 24/7 gyms: Anytime Fitness, Snap Fitness, Jetts, City Fitness — all have fob/app access
